keys.effect: Anti-aliasing and upscaling mode: None, FXAA, TAA, DLAA, DLSS, FFXSR2, XESS
keys.notes: DLAA runs 100% native resolution and bypasses DLSS upscaling, cratering framerates at 5120x1440. DLSS must be set to enable temporal upscaling.

keys.effect: Deep Learning Super Sampling reconstruction preset: UltraPerformance, Performance, Balanced, Quality, UltraQuality
keys.notes: Requires AntiAliasing set to DLSS. On 1440p and ultrawide panels, Quality provides sharp native-like reconstruction with high framerate headroom.

keys.effect: NVIDIA DLSS 3 Optical Flow Frame Generation toggle for RTX 40-series GPUs
keys.notes: Requires Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS) in Windows. Note that in-game settings changes may revert this key in some builds.

keys.effect: First-person on-foot horizontal field of view angle in degrees (60.0 - 100.0)
keys.notes: Default 75° creates severe tunnel-vision and peripheral warping on 32:9 and 21:9 ultrawide screens, triggering nausea and headaches.

keys.effect: First-person cockpit horizontal field of view angle in degrees (60.0 - 100.0)
keys.notes: Aligns first-person flight camera with 90° third-person perspective to eliminate vestibular mismatch.

keys.effect: High Dynamic Range tone mapping profile: Off, HDR400, HDR600, HDR1000
keys.notes: Capping at HDR600 prevents blinding 1000-nit localized highlight spikes on OLED panels, significantly reducing ocular fatigue and headaches.

keys.effect: Terrain, planetary flora, and ship shadow resolution and cascade filtering: Low, Medium, High, Ultra
keys.notes: High eliminates the heavy frame-time stutter of Ultra shadow cascades on procedural flora while retaining sharp shadow silhouettes.

keys.effect: Planetary atmospheric fog, cloud density, and volumetric light shafts: Low, Medium, High, Ultra
keys.notes: Ultra volumetrics cause significant frame drops during atmospheric entry and planetary storms. High preserves cloud layers smoothly.

keys.effect: Screen-space reflection fidelity and ray density: Low, Medium, High, Ultra
keys.notes: Ultra causes aggressive specular shimmering on wet surfaces and space stations, creating ocular fatigue. High eliminates shimmering.

keys.effect: Planetary terrain distance LOD and procedural vegetation density: Low, Medium, High, Ultra
keys.notes: High eliminates draw-call spikes during low-altitude flights and surface sprints with negligible visual loss.

keys.effect: Voxel displacement detail and tessellation factor: Low, Medium, High, Ultra
keys.notes: High removes heavy vertex shader compute hitches during terrain manipulation and traversal.

keys.effect: Worker thread pool allocation for high-priority procedural generation and physics tasks
keys.notes: For 8-core CPUs (e.g. Ryzen 7 5800X3D), match to physical core count (8) to eliminate thread oversubscription and CPU traversal hitches.

keys.effect: Worker thread pool allocation for background asset streaming and decompression
keys.notes: Prevents the engine default 12/12 (24 thread allocation) from stalling the Vulkan command queue on 16-thread processors.

keys.effect: Screen transition style for hyperspace warps, teleporters, and portal transitions: true (white flash), false (dark fade)
keys.notes: Critical photosensitivity setting. Setting to false prevents sudden luminance spikes on HDR panels during warp sequences.

keys.effect: Camera oscillation amplitude during boost, mining beam firing, atmospheric turbulence, and explosions: 0-10
keys.notes: Note engine spelling 'CamerShakeStrength'. 0 completely eliminates jarring camera jolts.

keys.effect: Full-screen pulsing color and edge strobe overlays during environmental hazard storms: 0.0-1.0
keys.notes: 0.100000 provides subtle storm indication without violent red/toxic pulsing flashes that trigger eye strain.

keys.effect: Dynamic edge darkening vignette applied during ship steering and boost: true, false
keys.notes: Disabling prevents pulsing edge darkening on ultrawide monitors that triggers vestibular discomfort.

keys.effect: Underwater peripheral blur and depth of field strength: 0.0-1.0
keys.notes: Disabling prevents disorienting focus hunting while swimming.

keys.effect: Vortex sky spinning animation during planetary distress events and spooky biomes
keys.notes: Disabling prevents visual vertigo and vestibular discomfort.

keys.effect: Secondary gameplay motion blur factor: 0-180
keys.notes: Keep at 0 alongside MotionBlurStrength in graphics settings.

keys.effect: High contrast backing for mission objectives and dialogue text prompts
keys.notes: Improves readability on high-resolution and ultrawide screens.

manual_only_settings.reason: Prevents oversized HUD icons on 1440p displays.

manual_only_settings.recommendation: Install centred HUD community mod (or run centred 21:9 resolution)
manual_only_settings.reason: No Man's Sky natively supports 32:9 world rendering but pushes HUD widgets to 5120px screen edges. Mods clamp HUD to 21:9 or 16:9 safe zone.

notes: No Man's Sky runs on Hello Games' proprietary Vanguard engine using Vulkan 1.3.
Native 32:9 (5120x1440) and 21:9 (3440x1440) super ultrawide rendering is fully supported in borderless fullscreen mode.
On high-resolution displays, always use AntiAliasing=DLSS (not DLAA) with DLSSQuality=Quality to secure consistent 60+ FPS.
First-person FOV (FoVOnFootFP, FoVInShipFP) should be raised to 90° on ultrawide monitors to prevent claustrophobic tunnel vision.
HDR600 mode is recommended over HDR1000 on OLED monitors to prevent ocular fatigue from intense localized flashes.
For 8-core CPUs like AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D, setting NumHighThreads=8 and NumLowThreads=8 in TKGRAPHICSSETTINGS.MXML avoids thread contention.
AllowWhiteScreenTransitions should be set to false to protect photosensitive users from sudden maximum-luminance flashes during warp travel.
